title: Senior Data Analyst
description_html:
About the role

The analytics group supports pricing and claims teams across the country.

What you'll do

  • Own the claims team's dashboards in Tableau and Power BI
  • Design A/B testing for customer letters
  • Write SQL against our PostgreSQL warehouse

What you bring

  • Five or more years in analytics
  • Strong data visualisation
  • Mentoring junior analysts

Nice to have

  • dbt
  • Python

Pay and benefits

  • Salary: $88,000–$98,000 CAD per year
  • Four weeks of vacation and a yearly learning budget
